meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:本轮首行输出 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`,把改动分级为 LIGHT 或 HEAVY,注册目标、开记事本、跟踪 todo,并跑真实界面证据确认交付。
howto.when: 当用户请求 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在当前对话中时读取并接管;若同时带有 ulw-loop 或 ulw-execute 契约,则按该契约执行。

say.note: 本轮首行输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug,先写失败用例
say.note: 先产出 RED 用例,再实现到 GREEN

say.text: 在 ultrawork 模式下,帮我跑这个接口的 HTTP 证据
say.note: 用 curl 抓状态行、响应头和响应体

howto.what_en: Turns on ultrawork mode: its first line is `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`. Claude surveys skills and code, triages the change as LIGHT or HEAVY, opens a notepad, tracks todos, and captures real-surface evidence before calling work done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation; an accompanying ulw-loop or ulw-execute contract supersedes it.

say_en.note: First line of the turn: ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this bug - failing test first.
say_en.note: Writes a RED test, then fixes it to GREEN.

say_en.text: In ultrawork mode, capture HTTP evidence for this endpoint.
say_en.note: Runs curl and saves the artifact.
